summary: bound.PageOptions/mcpPageConfig carry an optional ArrayField hint naming the response's real item-list key directly, bypassing boundedSingleArrayPageObject's auto-detect scan (which bails to a dead-end, non-resumable preview as soon as a second top-level array field is present). classes_catalog, classes_search, and workouts_list set ArrayField to "data" -- their real response always carries a sibling array ("instructors" on the classes tools) regardless of query, so a regen must keep this hint wired or unprojected oversized responses on these three tools silently lose pagination and fall back to an unparsable raw preview.
reason: Live retesting found an unprojected classes_search call over budget returned a raw, non-resumable preview blob, while the same call with select=data.id took the proper resumable next_cursor envelope -- purely because select happened to drop the sibling "instructors" array and leave exactly one top-level array field, which is what the underlying auto-detect heuristic actually requires. Naming the item field directly for these known-shape endpoints makes unprojected and projected calls equally resumable.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test/govulncheck and verify_skill.py all green. New tests TestEndpointPageResponseArrayFieldHintSurvivesASiblingArray (bound package) and TestMCPToolPageResultTextArrayFieldHintHandlesResidualInstructorsArray (mcp package) both drive a data+instructors fixture through the real production call path and assert a resumable next_cursor envelope, not a preview.
